content: Kadaudok en Reupen kan

Iet kadaudok en Reupen kan, nein Seikop pwutak mesenih. (Pwehki eh wiahiong nsenen pwopwoud ong emen en eh pahpao pekehi ko, kahrehda eh katiasang pwungen mesenih me e ahneki, oh pwuhngo kohieng Sosep.
Ahpw kadaudok en Suda kehlailla sang koaros oh irail me kin kihda kaunen kadaudok kan koaros.)
Reupen, mesenih en nein Seikop pwutak kan, naineki pwutak pahmen: Anok, Pallu, Esron, oh Karmi.
Iet kadaudok en Soel kan sang ehu dih lel ehu dih: Semaia, Kok, Simei, Maika, Reaia, Paal, oh Peera. Nanmwarki lapalap en Asiria, Tiklad Pileser, kalowehdi Peera, emen kaunen kadaudoko oh kalipehla.
Me pahn sansal pah iei mwaren kaunen peneinei kan en kadaudok en Reupen me ntinting nan pwuken peneinei: Seiel, Sekaraia,
oh Pela, nein Asas oh eh pahpa kahlap Sema, kisehn peneineien Soel. Peneinei wet kin kousoan Aroer oh nan sahpw sang wasao ni paliepeng kolahng Nepo oh Paal Meon.
Neirail mahn tohto nan wehin Kilead, ihme kahrehda ar kousoanla nan sahpwo oh lellahng palimesehn sapwtehn me kohla lel ni Pillap Iupreitis.
Ni mwehin Nanmwarki Sohl, kadaudok en Reupen mahweniong mehn Akar, kemeirailla, oh kousoanla nan sapwarailo ni palimesehn Kilead.
Kadaudok en Kad kan
Kadaudok en Kad kin kousoan ni paliepeng en Reupen nan wehin Pasan kolahng palimese lellahng Saleka.
Soel me tepin wiahla kaunen peneinei, oh Sapam me tepin wiahla kaunen peneinei keriaun kesempwal. Sanai oh Sapat me tepin wiahla kaunen peneinei teikan nan Pasan.
Meteikan me wia kisehn kadaudoko iei irail me wia tohn peneinei pwukat: Maikel, Mesullam, Sipa, Sorai, Sakan, Sia, oh Eper.
Re wia kadaudok en Apieil nein Uri, me arail pahpa kahlap ako koadoudoudo nin duwe met: Apieil, Uri, Saroa, Kilead, Maikel, Sesisai, Sado, Pus.
Ahi, nein Apdiel me pahpa kahlapki Kuni, iei ih me wia moangen peneinei pwukat.
Re kin kousoan nan sapwen Pasan oh Kilead, nan kahnimw kan oh nan sahpw en kamwenge mahn koaros nan Saron.
(Pwuhken peneinei pwukat wiawidahr ni mwehin Sodam, nanmwarkien Suda oh Seropoham Keriemen, nanmwarkien Israel.)
Karis en Kadaudok en Palimese kan
Mie sounpei 44,760 nan kadaudok en Reupen, Kad, oh Palimesehn Manase, me koahiek en doadoahngki mehn sansar, kedlahs, oh kesik ketieu.
Re ahpw kohla mahweniong kadaudok en Akar pwukat: Sedur, Napis, oh Nodap.
Re koapworopworki Koht oh kapakapohng oh peki sapwellime sawas, Koht eri ketin kupwure arail kapakap oh mweidohng irail en powehdi mehn Akar oh neirail sounpei kan.
Re kalowehdi ar imwintihti ko oh kihsang irail kamel 50,000, sihpw 250,000, ahs 2,000, oh salihedi sounpei 100,000.
Re kemehla imwintihti tohto, pwehki mahweno iei kupwur en Koht. Re ahpw koukousoante nan sahpwo lao lel ahnsou me re kalipilipalao.
Aramas en Palimesehn Manase
Aramas en palimesehn Manase kousoanla nan sapwen Pasan lellahng Paal Ermon, Senir, oh Nahna Ermon, ni paliepeng, oh re inenen kaparaparala mehlel.
Me pahn sansal pah iei kaunen arail peneinei kan: Eper, Isi, Eliel, Asriel, Seremaia, Odapaia, oh Sadiel. Irail koaros wia sounpei kehlail, oh wia kaun ndand oh sansal nan peneinei lap akan.
Kadaudok en Palimese Kalipilipala
Aramas ako eri soaloalopwoatohng Koht en arail pahpa kahlap ako, re sohpeisang oh kaudokiong koht en wehi kan me Koht ketin koakoahsang nan sahpwo.

Koht eri ketin kamwakidada kapehd en Pul, Nanmwarki Lapalap en Asiria (me pil kin mwarenki Tiklad Pileser) pwe en mahweniong sapwarailo. Ih eri kalipehla kadaudok en Reupen, Kad, oh Palimesehn Manase, oh koasoaneiraildiong nan Ala, Apor, oh Ara, oh ni keilen Pillap Kosan.

footnotes.text: 5.22 AHNSOU ME RE KALIPILIPALA: Kereniong pahr 733 Mwohn Krais, mehn Asiria kalowehdi paliepeng en Israel iangahki sapwen mehn Israel ni palimesehn Pillap Sordan, oh kalipehla aramas ako (tehk 2 Nan. 15.29.)
